description: Golden-hour rim-light editorial portrait. Choose camera: Canon R5 + 85mm f/1.2 or Hasselblad H6D + 80mm. Returns the styled prompt stack for your shot and the aspect_ratio to make it at — pair it with generate_image and pass that aspect_ratio along.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional frame shape. Replaces the shape the style uses by default. The answer carries aspect_ratio: pass it to generate_image so the picture is made at that shape.

style.description: canon_85mm = Canon R5 portrait standard. hasselblad_80mm = medium-format luxury.

subject.description: What you want to shoot. E.g. "a woman walking through a hotel lobby" or "morning coffee on the balcony".

name: apply_magic_hour_portrait
title: Apply Magic Hour Portrait
